Mission Local’s May 13, 2023 “People We Meet” piece reported that three friends arrived at a GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to buy *The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom*. They wanted the physical collector’s edition, and their early arrival got them the first three spots to purchase one.
